The '''Jabba's Throne Room''' was a club-bar on [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]]. It was exactly modeled after the throne room of the late [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Although the architecture and atmosphere was authentic, some of the dimensions had been stretched to accommodate more seats.

==Description==
It served a variety of cuisines including roast [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]]. The club's staff consisted of look-alikes of former entourage members, including a "[[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]]" impersonator. The clientele of this restaurant was noticeably better behaved than those in other restaurants and bars in the [[Trader's Plaza]].<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>

It purported to host the original [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] and was said to resemble the [[Palace Museum]] on Tatooine. Jabba's Throne Room offered patrons the opportunity to "Visit Jabba's Guest Quarters with a Pleasure Slave" and "Face the Mighty [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] in the Pit of Death." To most victims of Jabba, the restaurant was amusing at best, and outright insulting at worst.<ref name="Shield of Lies" />

==History==
In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] visited the club-bar after purchasing the bestselling ''[[The Lost Secrets of the Jedi]]'' from a branch of the [[Galactic Archives]]. In here, Skywalker was amused to find a not-so-perfect representation of the galactic gangster's intimidating headquarters, though he decided to stay for dinner after hearing the surprisingly good music and catching a glimpse of the roast nerf. Skywalker was seated underneath a "frozen [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]" and served a drink from an "[[Oola/Legends|Oola]]" look-alike. He finally called it quits after a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] actor failed to impress him with his [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] impression, and was relieved he didn't stick around long enough to see the [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] impersonation.<ref name="Shield of Lies" />
